import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a comprehensive visualization with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep (colored by Stress Level)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                     c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='YlOrRd', s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality\n(colored by Stress)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1, label='Stress Level')

# 2. Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=15, color=colors[0], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 3. BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax3.bar(range(len(bmi_counts)), bmi_counts.values, color=colors[1:len(bmi_counts)+1], edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(bmi_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(bmi_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Physical Activity Level vs Daily Steps
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax4.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Daily Steps'], 
           c=colors[2], s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
sleep_disorder = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorder_counts = sleep_disorder.value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax5.pie(disorder_counts.values, labels=disorder_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors[3:3+len(disorder_counts)],
                                     startangle=90)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax5.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Heart Rate Distribution by Gender
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
gender_groups = df.groupby('Gender')['Heart Rate'].apply(list)
ax6.boxplot([gender_groups.get(g, []) for g in df['Gender'].unique()], 
            labels=df['Gender'].unique(), patch_artist=True)
for patch, color in zip(ax6.artists, colors[:len(df['Gender'].unique())]):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.6)
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Stress Level vs Sleep Quality (boxplot)
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
stress_levels = sorted(df['Stress Level'].unique())
sleep_by_stress = [df[df['Stress Level'] == sl]['Quality of Sleep'].values for sl in stress_levels]
bp = ax7.boxplot(sleep_by_stress, labels=stress_levels, patch_artist=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors[:len(stress_levels)]):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.6)
ax7.set_xlabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Sleep Quality by Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 8. Occupation Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
occupation_counts = df['Occupation'].value_counts().head(8)
ax8.barh(range(len(occupation_counts)), occupation_counts.values, color=colors[:len(occupation_counts)])
ax8.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_counts)))
ax8.set_yticklabels(occupation_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax8.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Top Occupations', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 9. Correlation heatmap of numerical features
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0,
            square=True, ax=ax9, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, annot_kws={'fontsize': 8})
ax9.set_title('Correlation Matrix', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
